tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Discover the source kinds, operations, scopes, and current connection health available to this run.

tools.name: observe_source
tools.description: Record one minimized, hash-addressed source observation before using it in a briefing or sourced claim.

tools.name: list_feed_items
tools.description: List Quiet Desk feed items with lane, agent, time, status, and text filters.

tools.name: get_feed_item
tools.description: Read one feed item with its claims, source references, run, proposal, and proof states.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List minimized source records and user-openable deep links without returning secrets.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: Read one source record and the claims that cite it.

tools.name: publish_feed_item
tools.description: Publish a distilled feed item whose every claim cites one or more supplied source records.

tools.name: update_feed_item
tools.description: Append a revision to an existing feed item after reading its current revision.

tools.name: withdraw_feed_item
tools.description: Withdraw an incorrect or no-longer-useful feed item while preserving the audit trail.

tools.name: propose_action
tools.description: Create an exact, expiring external-action proposal with target, account, revision, payload preview, and payload hash.

tools.name: record_feedback
tools.description: Record a user preference or correction against a feed item.

tools.name: complete_run
tools.description: End a run explicitly as completed, partial, or failed with completed steps, remaining steps, and a concise summary.

context_tools.name: context_capabilities
context_tools.description: Discover the local Context Kernel, its current watermark, and the exact roles and authority scopes granted to this connection.

context_tools.name: open_run
context_tools.description: Open one idempotent, bounded Context Kernel run under a server-authorized role.

context_tools.name: record_scratch_cue
context_tools.description: Retain one minimized, non-citable cue for at most 24 hours outside the durable ledger.

context_tools.name: record_evidence
context_tools.description: Record minimized public or work evidence with provenance; human-confirmed evidence is unavailable to ordinary agents.

context_tools.name: assemble_context
context_tools.description: Build a bounded Context Pack at an inspectable ledger watermark with explicit, observed, and inferred material kept separate.

context_tools.name: refresh_context
context_tools.description: Refresh a prior Context Pack from its cursor using the full workspace-authenticated receipt returned by assemble_context; the pack remains a derived view, not memory.

context_tools.name: search_entities
context_tools.description: Search current context entities through the rebuildable local index.

context_tools.name: get_entity
context_tools.description: Read one current context entity with its revision, evidence basis, and lifecycle state.

context_tools.name: append_context_event
context_tools.description: Append an observed or inferred proposal with optimistic revision control; it cannot confirm a belief or exercise human authority.

context_tools.name: get_changes
context_tools.description: Read context changes after a ledger cursor for refresh and cross-harness handoff.

context_tools.name: checkpoint_run
context_tools.description: Persist bounded, resumable progress without claiming completion or an external side effect.

context_tools.name: complete_context_run
context_tools.description: Close a Context Kernel run explicitly as completed, partial, or failed without implying approval, delivery, merge, or deployment.

intentionally_absent.name: approve_action
intentionally_absent.reason: Approval is a user authority and cannot be delegated to the proposing provider.

intentionally_absent.name: execute_action
intentionally_absent.reason: The MVP has no trusted external executor; proposals remain drafts until that boundary is implemented and reviewed.
